name.en-US: Sermons for the Feasts of the Saints

description.la: Sermones Bernardi de sanctis: Andreas, Clemens, Martinus, Paulus, Purificatio, Annuntiatio, Benedictus, Joannes Baptista, Petrus et Paulus, Assumptio, Nativitas Mariae, Michael, Omnes sancti, Malachias et alii.
description.en-US: Bernard’s sermons for the feasts of the saints and of Our Lady (Saint Andrew, Clement, Martin, the Conversion of Paul, the Purification, Annunciation and Assumption of Mary, Benedict, John the Baptist, Peter and Paul, Michael, All Saints, Malachy, Humbert and others), grouped by feast. The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 183, 1854). Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os sermões de Bernardo para as festas dos santos e de Nossa Senhora (André, Clemente, Martinho, a conversão de Paulo, a Purificação, a Anunciação e a Assunção de Maria, Bento, João Batista, Pedro e Paulo, Miguel, Todos os Santos, Malaquias, Humberto e outros), agrupados por festa.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182-184)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182-184 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), works 6209, 6192, 6168, 6193, 6187, 6179, 6182, 6196, 6199, 6210, 6194, 6184, 6174, 6201, 21529, 6195, 6202, 6208, 6197, 6200, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: One group per feast or piece, as the Corpus Corporum divides them. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
